walkthroughs.body_html:
Abstract Data Structures — a core area of Computer Science.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Abstract Data Structures brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Abstract Data Structures.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: What is abstraction in computer science?
options: Writing code that does not work.
Making something abstract art or vague.
Removing unnecessary detail to focus on essential features of a problem.
Encrypting data so it cannot be read.
